market.title: Installations

market.loadFailed: The installations could not be loaded.
market.noPackages: There are no packages to install. Upload one first.
market.requested: Installation requested. It is pending until it is approved.

market.requestFailed: The installation could not be requested.

disabledReason.approver_lost: The administrator who approved it is no longer an administrator
disabledReason.key_revoked: The publisher's signing key was revoked

market.customCode: This package runs code on the server.
market.changedGrants: These approvals are no longer valid because what the capability can do has changed. Approve them again:

market.problems: This package does not fit here
market.approveSubset: Approving fewer capabilities than it asks for makes the parts of the package that need them stop working.
market.actionFailed: The change could not be made.
market.disableBody: Its actions stop at once. You can enable it again.
market.revokeBody: This cannot be undone. Its actions stop at once and the layouts and placements it added are deleted. Forms it created stay.
market.formsUsingRules: Writes to these forms are refused while the installation is not active:
market.logNote: Only digests and sizes are kept, for 30 days.
market.wholeProject: on every form of the project
market.wholeWorkspace: on every form of the workspace
market.needsReapproval: The administrator who approved it is no longer an administrator. Approve it again.
market.marketLead: Find packages to install in this workspace: form templates, page templates, apps and plugins.
market.adminOnly: Only workspace owners and administrators see installations and can install packages.
market.memberNote: Installing needs a workspace owner or administrator.
market.publicPages: These pages can be opened without an account: {list}
market.detailLoadFailed: The package could not be loaded.
market.fromMarketNote: Layouts of installed packages are placed by their installation. Here they are listed for reference.
market.fromMarketEmpty: No installed package has a layout for this slot.
market.sitePagesNote: Installing into a project creates a draft site. Nothing is public until someone publishes it. Later upgrades update that site directly, including when it is published.

market.callsEmpty: No calls that change data yet.

market.catLead: The operations a plugin can call through the host, grouped by area. A plugin asks for a capability id; each id opens the operations listed under it.
market.catFailed: The catalogue could not be loaded.
